prompt:
From the user’s English, Swedish or German news paragraph, return every named business exactly once, in first-mention order across all forms. Output only a valid JSON array of strings ([], if none); no wrapper, Markdown, comments or prose.

Count plain names, legal names, possessives, products or services, and web or email domains. Exclude people and titles, cities, regions, countries, product categories, generic descriptions and unnamed businesses.

Canonicalise each mention:
- Remove possessive 's or ’s and Swedish or German genitive -s. Strip trailing legal forms AB, GmbH, AG, Ltd, PLC, Inc., LLC, Corp., AS, ASA, Oy, Oyj, A/S, ApS, SA, SAS, B.V., N.V. with or without a final period. Preserve actual name words such as Group, Systems, Labs, Partners, Works, Freight, Energy and Foods.
- For a product or service formed from a company name plus a product word, return only the parent name, even if it never appears alone. Merge sibling products under that parent.
- For a website or email domain, use its owner’s name as written elsewhere in the paragraph. If there is no other naming form, discard www. and any email local part, then capitalise the first letter of the part before the top-level domain.

Keep the text’s capitalisation and diacritics except for domain-only capitalisation. Never translate, abbreviate or ASCII-fold. Merge repeated and alternate mentions of the same company before output.
